title: Module 34 — Big Data & Data Architecture
description: Build a warehouse on your laptop with DuckDB: generate a dataset, run an OLAP aggregate, write columnar Parquet and compare it to CSV, do a partitioned read, and build an idempotent, quality-checked batch ETL script.

Write Parquet — compare size and speed vs CSV
